from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """One company's net profit attributable to shareholders from a financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as appearing in the document")
    profit_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label as written for the profit metric")
    profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="The net profit amount reported in yuan (can be negative)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
